corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez verb ሰሐበ with feminine plural object suffix -ኦን is ወሰሐቦን ('and his appearance drew them'); the printed glyph is 1st-order ሐ, not 7th-order ሖ.
The printed Fidel at the end of ኩብሽ has the 6th-order ሽ top-stroke, which is the standard Amharic name of the skin disease (ኩብሽ).
Removed stray ASCII period caused by an ink speck before the Ethiopic word-space colon in ያጠ ፡ ሥርን (የዕፀ ሥርን).
